reviews.text: This is the only place I am comfortable to bring my pup! The team is so kind and they only hire people that love animals. The general manager Tiasha is truly a gem. She goes above and beyond to make sure you and your pup are taken care of! I cannot say enough good things about her. I love how communicative the team is and that they show my dog love as if he is their own. My dog gets so excited when we turn down the street because he knows he is in for a day of love and fun! This is the ONLY place to bring your pet if you want peace of mind and the best care.
Great peace of mind leaving our pups here. We have tried home sitters many times and there is always an issue. Here they are well taken care of and safe. The staff is friendly and great with pets.

My 2 dogs a playful lab and tender shy beagle had the absolute best stay at Pawparazzi! The entire staff was so caring, sending us daily report cards with pics, videos and notes of how they did.
My husband and I truly were able to enjoy our vacation knowing our pets were in the best hands. The facility has so many fun extras including day care, sniffari room,  peanut butter kong treats. My dogs also had an amazing grooming on the day of pick up. We are so grateful and know will be returning again. It is very evident the owner Krista truly loves pets. We are grateful to have found such a special place.

We can't speak highly enough of Pawparazzi! Not only do we love how clean and safe the environment is for Rowan, our wonder pup, but his palpable joy every time we walk through the door (not to mention turning into the parking lot) makes our hearts dance. The staff is warm, knowledgeable, and communicative. The social media feeds on FB and Instagram make it easy to see what kind of day the dogs are having and the varied activities like dig pits, pool parties, and sniffaris, provide options for additional enrichment. But honestly, the dog packs create their own adventures. Rowan has made friends and it's obvious how much he wishes we could take him every day. :-) We appreciate how the Pawparrazi staff make an effort to know each dog and were especially impressed by the approach that Krista, the owner, takes in accepting dogs by observing a dog's personality rather than judging the dog by his/her/their breed.

Rowan has spent the night (and will again, soon) and that experience was leagues better than anything my childhood dogs experienced in kennels. Our sense is that there is an abundance of affection for every pup and cat that crosses the threshold at Pawparrazi and we're grateful that we found them. (We know Rowan is!)

Absolutely love this place for when we know we need to run some errands and would rather have our dog have an engaging day playing with other dogs instead of being at home alone. We have also used their boarding services and have no complaints at all. The staff is wonderful and our dog Kobe always seems so happy to see them. Whenever we pull into the parking lot he immediately knows where he is and gets super excited to get inside which is probably the best review you can get for a place with these services.
A very clean place. I trust my dog with them. Courteous people. They care for the dogs. One of the only places I trust to leave my dog for a few days

Outstanding! If you are looking for a day care for your 4 feet babies, do not hesitate on going to Pawparazzi, my experience and my cat experience has beyond expectations. Since the moment I started sending them emails the service was excellent, all my emails was replied, all my questions solved, and when I met the team, I had the opportunity of going early in the morning and then in the afternoon, I met about 7 people and all the team, each of them, where just fantastic, friendly and helpful. Good luck guys! I hope to see you soon.

Best dog boarding and daycare we've been to. Love the staff, excellent dog vetting process. They separate the dogs based on energy level/temperament, which not all daycares do, and it's been great for our little dog man. Love these guys. Give them a shot! You can rest easy knowing your dogs are in good hands.

They broke my dog. Seriously, I had to board her for two weeks due to a family emergency, and she came back a different girl - in a good way! Pawparazzi has been my go to boarding facility even though I don't live locally. The staff understand K9 behavior and how to instill good habits and manners in daily interactions/play. They continued the habits training that I we were working on at home, and I'll be adding additional training sessions during my next booking. Not only do they take excellent care of my girl, they took great care of me when my return date kept changing. Pricing is fair and clearly communicated, and they offer loads of enrichment options. While I missed my girl, I was completely at peace with her care during my trip.
Very welcoming, with friendly staff. My dogs enjoy coming here! Great for a few hours out of the day.

Our experience with Pawparazzi.
For approximately one year, we have been taking our Doberman off and on to PAWparazzi. However, during our most recent visit, we were contacted a few hours after drop-off and informed that our dog had anxiety and excessive energy and strength for them to handle. While the staff noted that he is a sweet dog, they indicated that his needs would require too much attention, potentially detracting from the care provided to other dogs in the day camp program.
We were disappointed to learn that our dog was deemed unsuitable for the facility and were advised to seek alternative care options. Additionally, we were surprised that no alternative solutions, such as private training sessions which we understand Pawparazzi offers, were proposed to address his behavior or energy levels. This leads us to question whether the trainers are adequately equipped to handle high-energy breeds like Dobermans, or if there is a preference for working with smaller or lower-energy dogs.
Anyhow, happy to take my business elsewhere, where professional trainers deal with a types of dogs not just sissy dogs.
